audit.whatIsWrong: content win[0..6] = [Skill,Skill,Skill,Braum,Braum,Braum,Sona] but full phases[0..6].side = [Braum,Braum,Braum,Skill,Skill,Skill,Skill] — inverted mirror-image on every row, same pattern as the blitzcrank and brand matchups in this batch.
audit.why: Braum's engage range (300 on Winter's Bite (Q)) is too short to threaten Sona early, so levels 1-3 are an even poke duel gated by his passive Concussive Blows; his shields and Glacial Fissure (R) take over 4-6, then Sona's aura stacking outscales a purely defensive tank with no scaling damage at two items — matching content's whys[].
audit.corrected: Set phases[0..6].side to match win[0..6] (no content edit needed) and rewrote each why around the real mechanic.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no real cooldown number.
audit.why: Winter's Bite (Q) sets up Concussive Blows (passive stun after 4 stacking hits) and Unbreakable (E) blocks a directional projectile — naming both makes the punish window concrete.

audit.whatIsWrong: Concussive Blows (his passive stun trigger) and Unbreakable's directional block against Crescendo never reached breakdown.trading or the dos/donts, only content.spikes.
audit.why: Braum's stun is a stacking passive, not a cast — spacing after his Q, not dodging a skillshot, is the real counterplay; and E can shield-block Crescendo from one angle.
